name: 91311 · Chatsworth, CA
findings: ZIP 91311 (Chatsworth) has 194 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91311 (Chatsworth) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91311 (Chatsworth) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 32% of all organizations here have no identified type.
